Roger Zhen

Email
zhenrogerobfuscate@gmail.com

Roger Zhen is a 10th-grade student at Clear Lake High School (ranking 1st out of 668) with a strong interest in mathematics and biology. He has been active in math competitions since elementary school, becoming the Texas Mathcounts champion in 6th grade and placing in the top 12 nationally in 7th grade. He has qualified for the USA Junior Math Olympiad (USAJMO) for three consecutive years and has also participated in the USA Computing Olympiad (USACO). He is currently working on a summer research project in the lab.
